units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:5">Kel. XXIII, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:9">XXVIII, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00156"><he>זֶוֶט</he></cite>; a. fr.—

senses.gloss: a place adapted for catching fish in nets, fishing coast, fishery.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81b:4">B. Kam. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מלא חבל ח׳ בדרומה</he> a rope’s length (district) of fishing coast south of it (the Lake of Tiberias); <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 8:18">Tosef. ib. VIII, 18</cite> Var. ed. Zuck.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 47b:17">Erub. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ שבין וכ׳</he> a fishpond between two territories.

senses.gloss: [cut off, excluded, cmp. חוּלִּין, הֶפְקֵר,] ḥerem, property set apart for priest’s or Temple use; doomed to destruction.
units: Ned. II, 4 אם כח׳ של שמים if (he said, This shall be to me) like the ḥerem consecrated to the Temple, opp. ח׳ של כהנים assigned to the private use of priests.
Ib. 5 נדר בח׳ … בחֶרְמוֹ של ים if he made a vow of abstinence using the word ḥerem, and he says, I meant the ḥerem of the sea (fisher’s net).
Ib. I, 2 כינויין לח׳ verbal substitutes for ḥerem (effecting prohibition); a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43b:8">Snh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>מעל עכן בג׳ ח׳</he> Akhan committed three sacrileges.
Ned. II, 4 סתם ח׳ containing the expression ḥerem unqualified.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>חַרְמֵי הכהנים</he> the dedications as priestly property.
Arakh. VIII, 6 סתם ח׳ לבדק הבית unqualified dedications (this be ḥerem) go to the repair of the Temple; a. fr.—[Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ top שצבעה בחרם, read: בחֶרֶת.]—V. חֵירוּם.
